events.description: Hands your AI agent the store work you ask for in Store OS: syncing a shop, writing listings, drafting or sending buyer replies, setting stock on shops, checking tracking, helping set up a shop, and your messages

conventions.guide: Start with `app guide`: the app's own manual. `<module> <operation> --help` lists an operation's parameters; the full manual (rules, recipes, caveats) is AGENT_APP.md in the app's directory.
